reply: Read it: 7 gaps in the shared simulator tools (sim-lease and sim-test). The worst is that reusing an already-booted phone takes no lease, so two repos drove Duo 1 at once today and the Home review lost 7 tries. Two runs also held the one Mac lock at once, and a stopped run leaves Duo 1 in Dark mode. I filed it as step sim-lease-gaps, near the top of the roadmap, and sent it to the coordinator to start a lane. Gaps 1-3 get a failing test first, then the fix. Gaps 4-7 each get a measure or a question to you. Slot 2 (the second Duo) is one of those questions.
